question: What is the address of principal executive offices and ZIP code?
rationale: Inspected the cover pages of 5 representative docs (Amazon, Apple 2021, Amcor, AMD, Corning) plus BestBuy (which has its 10-K cover on page 2 rather than page 1) and saw a uniform SEC-mandated layout: the address and ZIP code appear immediately before two label markers — '(...principal executive offices)' and '(Zip Code)'. A single rule matches any span whose text contains those marker phrases and pairs it with its immediately preceding span (the value). This naturally handles four layout variants: separate address/ZIP spans (Apple, AMD, Amcor), inline 'value (Zip Code)' spans (Corning, BestBuy), single combined span (Johnson & Johnson), and full-cover-table spans (General Mills). One rule, first verify yielded match_rate=1.0 across all 10 docs at sum_avg_cost_ratio=0.0082 — all three soft-target stopping criteria met.
